council.title: Council
council.description: Nine agents read the business with deterministic tools and propose decisions backed by evidence. They don't do mental arithmetic or execute anything: you decide.

cfo.name: CFO · Treasury and distribution
cfo.mission: How much to keep, distribute and reinvest; tax provisions; when to raise compensation; cash alerts.

commercial.name: Sales director
commercial.mission: Stalled deals, next best action, close forecast and the sources that convert.

pricing.name: Pricing and margin
pricing.mission: Unprofitable clients and services; when and how much to raise prices; what to package.

retention.name: Retention and upsell
retention.mission: At-risk clients, renewals and cross-selling according to your rules.

operations.name: Operations and capacity
operations.mission: Workload per partner, bottlenecks and when to hire or outsource.

growth.name: Growth and SEO
growth.mission: Which channel brings paying clients and where to invest in your own marketing.

fiscal.name: Tax and compliance
fiscal.mission: VAT, corporate tax (IS), withholdings and Verifactu calendar: it quantifies and warns in advance. Always to be checked with your accountant.

devils_advocate.name: Devil's advocate
devils_advocate.mission: Reviews anything high-impact before it's published: weak assumptions, risks and a pessimistic scenario.

chief_of_staff.name: Chief of Staff
chief_of_staff.mission: Prioritizes by euros and urgency, resolves conflicts between agents and prepares the Monday briefing.

cadence.weekly: {weekday, select, 1 {Every Monday} 2 {Every Tuesday} 3 {Every Wednesday} 4 {Every Thursday} 5 {Every Friday} 6 {Every Saturday} other {Every Sunday}} at {hour}:00

connect.title: A board of directors that doesn't make anything up
connect.body: Nine specialised agents read your contracts, invoices, pipeline, expenses and cash with deterministic tools, and propose decisions with the evidence in front of you. To start working they need a Claude or Groq API key.

key.title: Create an API key
key.body: In the Anthropic console (or Groq's, with open models), with a spending limit that suits you. Each agent also has its own monthly budget.

env.title: Store it on the server
env.body: As an environment variable. It never reaches the browser; without it, the council doesn't queue anything.

cron.title: Schedule the cron
cron.body: One call every hour kicks off the Monday briefing, the close on the 5th and the daily and weekly reviews.

policy.title: Set your financial policy
policy.body: In Settings → Council. Until then, sample values are used, and every recommendation says so.

empty.title: The council hasn't said anything yet
empty.body: When an agent finds something above your impact threshold, it will appear here with its calculation. If there's nothing relevant, it stays quiet: that's on purpose.

neverCalculates.title: No mental arithmetic
neverCalculates.body: Every figure comes from a tested tool. If a number in the text isn't in the evidence, it's rejected and regenerated.

evidence.title: Always evidence
evidence.body: Metric, value, period, source and a link to the screen. If data is missing, it says so.

readOnly.title: Read-only
readOnly.body: It doesn't create invoices, move money, change salaries or send emails. Accepting only creates tasks.

policy.title: The policy is yours
policy.body: You decide how much to keep and when to distribute; the agents apply it and cite the version.

professional.title: Check with your accountant
professional.body: Tax, employment and legal matters are flagged for professional review. It's never advice.

silence.title: Useful silence
silence.body: An impact threshold, and no repeating what's still open or what you dismissed recently. Fewer and better.

intro.agentsBody: Each with its mission, its tools and its schedule. You can turn them off, change their model or limit their budget.

card.professionalHint: Requires professional review: this isn't advice
card.acceptTitle: {count, plural, one {Accepting creates this task:} other {Accepting creates these # tasks:}}
card.dueIn: {days, plural, =0 {due today} one {in # day} other {in # days}}
card.acceptHint: The council doesn't execute anything: you do the tasks. After 30, 60 and 90 days, the real impact is compared with the estimate.
card.discardedToast: Dismissed. The reason goes back to the agent next time.
card.discardHint: The agent will read the reason next time and won't suggest it again for a while.
card.notChallenged: Not reviewed by the devil's advocate: {reason}

tasks.title: Council tasks
tasks.empty: No open tasks. When you accept a recommendation, its tasks appear here.

banners.noApiKey: The council is paused: the API key (Claude or Groq) is missing on the server. What was already published stays here.

new.title: Nothing new to decide
new.body: The agents have looked and there's nothing above your impact threshold. Staying quiet is an answer too.

postponed.title: Nothing snoozed
postponed.body: Whatever you snooze will come back to New on the day you choose.

accepted.title: Nothing accepted pending
accepted.body: Accepting a recommendation creates its tasks; once it's done, mark it and it moves to the history.

history.title: History empty
history.body: Done and dismissed recommendations stay here, with who decided and why.

reports.label: Council reports
reports.briefingHint: The week's 3–5 decisions, cash and traffic lights
reports.closeHint: Distribution: taxes, cushion, reinvestment and partners

briefing.decisions: {count, plural, =0 {This week's decisions} one {This week's decision} other {This week's # decisions}}
briefing.noDecisions: This week there's nothing above the threshold that deserves your attention. A good sign.
briefing.regenerate: Has anything changed since Monday? The Chief of Staff can redo the briefing with today's data.

empty.title: No briefing yet
empty.body: Every Monday at 8:00 the Chief of Staff turns what the agents have seen into an action plan: the top 3 critical actions, risk alerts, what to optimise and resolved conflicts, with cash and a traffic light per area.
empty.noApiKey: A Claude or Groq API key is needed to prepare it.

briefing.topActionsHint: What must be done before Tuesday
briefing.noTopActions: Nothing critical above the threshold this week. Good sign.
briefing.noRiskAlerts: Nothing that could break the business this week.
briefing.noOptimizations: Nothing new to optimise this week.
briefing.omitted: {count, plural, one {# point was removed because its figures didn't come from the data.} other {# points were removed because their figures didn't come from the data.}}

close.policyExample: Calculated with the sample policy: set yours in Settings → Council.
close.distributionHint: Of the available profit ({amount}), in your policy's order: taxes, cushion, reinvestment and partners. You can change any amount before accepting.
close.loss: Loss-making month: there's nothing to distribute

taxes.label: Taxes
taxes.hint: Corporate tax provision on the profit

cushion.label: Cushion
cushion.hint: What's still needed to reach the policy's months of fixed costs

close.cashLimited: Cash limits the distribution: {freeCash} is free after pending taxes and the target cushion ({target}).
close.invalidAmount: One of the amounts can't be understood
close.unbalanced: Adds up to {total}; it must add up to {available}
close.acceptHint: Accepting records the distribution with the policy version. It doesn't move money: you make the transfers yourselves, after checking with your accountant.
close.noDistribution: There's no proposed distribution this month
close.regenerate: Have you corrected expenses or balances? The CFO can redo last month's close.

empty.title: No monthly close yet
empty.body: On the 5th of every month, the CFO closes the previous month: figures, tax provision and a proposed distribution you can edit before accepting.
empty.noApiKey: A Claude or Groq API key is needed to prepare it.

runs.ownerOnly: Only owners can see the run log and its cost.
runs.costNote: Cost estimated with the public API prices (input, output and cache). The real bill is the provider's (Anthropic or Groq). If an agent uses up its budget, it pauses until next month.
runs.toolCalls: {count, plural, =0 {No tool calls} one {One tool call} other {# tool calls}}
runs.resultLine: {published, plural, =0 {Nothing published} one {One published} other {# published}} · {silenced, plural, =0 {nothing silenced} one {one silenced} other {# silenced}} · {attempts, plural, one {one attempt} other {# attempts}}

errors.noApiKey: The API key (Claude or Groq) is missing on the server: the council can't work.
errors.discardReason: Write the reason in one line (at least 3 letters).
errors.postponeDate: Choose how long to snooze it for.
errors.transition: That recommendation has already changed status. Reload the page.
errors.closeSum: The distribution must add up to exactly the available profit.
errors.closeInvalid: One of the distribution amounts isn't valid.
errors.closeAccepted: This close has already been accepted.
errors.closeNotAvailable: This close has no proposed distribution.
errors.notRunnable: This agent isn't run manually: it reviews what others publish.

policy.exampleTitle: These are sample values, not a recommendation
policy.exampleBody: The council works with them until you save your own (and says so in every recommendation). Adjust them to your reality; if they work for you as they are, adopt them as version 1.
policy.invalidTitle: The last saved version can't be read
policy.invalidBody: In the meantime, the council uses the sample values. Save a new version to fix it.

reserves.title: Reserves
reserves.description: The first thing set aside each month, before distributing anything.

distribution.title: Distributing what's left
distribution.description: After taxes and the cushion, how the available profit is distributed.

raise.title: Raising partner compensation
raise.description: The CFO only suggests it when all of this is met.

hire.title: Hiring
hire.description: Operations only suggests it when all of this is met.

projects.title: Projects and pricing
projects.description: The benchmark for pricing and margin.

silence.title: Useful silence
silence.description: Below the first threshold, the council stays quiet; from the second, the devil's advocate reviews before publishing.

cushion_months.label: Target cushion
cushion_months.hint: Months of fixed costs that must stay in cash.

corporate_tax_provision.label: Corporate tax provision
corporate_tax_provision.hint: On the month's profit. Check the rate with your accountant.

reinvestment.label: Reinvestment
reinvestment.hint: Share of the available profit for growth.

partners.label: Partners
partners.hint: The rest, according to the shareholdings.

raise_min_margin.label: Minimum margin
raise_min_margin.hint: Profit over revenue in those months.

raise_require_cushion.label: With the cushion met
raise_require_cushion.hint: No raise is suggested while cash doesn't cover the target cushion.

hire_min_pipeline.label: Minimum weighted pipeline
hire_min_pipeline.hint: MRR of open deals times their probability.

target_hourly_rate.label: Target hourly rate
target_hourly_rate.hint: What each invoiced hour should come to.

impact_threshold.label: Impact threshold
impact_threshold.hint: Below this impact, nothing is published (except tax deadlines).

high_impact_threshold.label: High-impact threshold
high_impact_threshold.hint: From here, the devil's advocate reviews.

policy.distributionPending: Reinvestment + partners must add up to 100%
policy.changedCount: {count, plural, one {One unsaved change} other {# unsaved changes}}
policy.adoptHint: Saving as is adopts the sample values as your version 1.

history.title: Versions
history.description: Each save is a new, immutable version. Each recommendation and each close keep the version they were made with.

errors.percent: Enter a percentage between 0 and 100 (up to two decimals).
errors.money: Enter an amount in euros (no minus sign).
errors.distributionSum: Reinvestment and partners must add up to 100%.
errors.highImpactBelow: It can't be lower than the impact threshold.

settings.agentsDescription: Turn each agent on or off, and choose its model, monthly budget and thresholds.

connection.readyBody: The API key is on the server. The agents work on their schedule and whenever you press “Run now”.
connection.missingBody: Without a Claude or Groq API key nothing is queued or run. What was already published is still visible.

agents.modelHint: Sonnet for day-to-day work; Opus for what needs more judgement.

errors.budget: The budget must be an amount in dollars.

rules.title: Cross-selling rules
rules.description: The retention agent uses them to suggest upsells: they're data, not code. A rule looks at what each client has contracted and what they're missing.
rules.formDescription: The words are searched for in each client's contract lines, ignoring case and accents.
rules.empty: No rules: the retention agent won't suggest cross-selling.
